Certified Refurbished Kiierr 272 Premier Laser Hair Cap Description

The Kiierr Laser Cap uses scientifically proven LLLT technology to regenerate your hair follicles giving them increased energy & blood flow. In just 30 minutes every other day you’ll see those frail follicles transform into thick & healthy hair once again!

The Certified Refurbished Kiierr 272Premier Laser Cap is extensively tested for performance, quality and safety. You can rest assured that you are purchasing an FDA cleared, like-new condition laser cap at a fraction of the cost!

All Kiierr Laser Caps use only premium laser diodes (650nm wavelength) for maximum hair growth (no LED’S). Although refurbished caps are not eligible for the 7-month growth guarantee (all sales on this certified refurbished product are final), a 2 year product warranty is included so you can feel confident your refurbished cap is protected!

 

  • FDA CLEARED: Peace of mind knowing your Kiierr Laser Cap is safe & effective.
  • FAST TREATMENTS: Use just 30 mins every other day, completely portable for on the go lifestyle.
  • 93% SUCCESS RATE IN CLINICAL STUDIES
  • DOCTOR RECOMMENDED

excerpt.rendered:
Use this cap for just 30 minutes every other day to get back a full, beautiful head of hair. Here’s a look at what is included with your Refurbished Kiierr 272 Premier:
  • Refurbished 272 Diode – Laser Helmet*
  • Plain Black Ball Cap (wear your laser cap anywhere)
  • Kiierr Stretch Fit Headband (secures helmet for comfort)
  • Wall Charger Power Plug
  • USB Cord
  • Portable Power Pack
  • User Manual & FAQ’s Guide
  • 1 year manufacturer’s warranty
